scope: FTS-SECTION-22 local SQLite whole indexed_search exact output and wall latency; manual independent review only

implementation.procedure: Inspect actual candidate, mirror and CLI path
implementation.acceptance: Only excerpt selection changed; mirror exact; same schema and semantics

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare full JSON against frozen de05d95c module on all fixtures and boundaries
reference_boundary.acceptance: Every output equal; one-tokenization test and existing errors preserved

data_integrity.procedure: Check all raw samples, source/dependency/input/seed hashes and fixed protocol
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing sample or changed input/code; all seven pairs retained

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians, ranges and ratios from raw positive finite milliseconds
numerical_sanity.acceptance: 1/2 section 512-word cases >=15% faster; all others candidate <=max(1.15*baseline,baseline+0.5ms)

measurement_validity.procedure: Inspect whole-call timing, warm pair, five calls per sample and seven alternating AB/BA pairs
measurement_validity.acceptance: Same store/DB/query/options; construction/load outside timing for both; no asymmetric cache; all cases reported

reproducibility.procedure: Independent fresh-context reviewer reruns real corpus and synthetic1/2/256 sections
reproducibility.acceptance: Full parity and frozen per-case performance thresholds pass; otherwise block adoption
